tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa snying po don gyi gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// na mo gu ru shrī badzra yo gi ni/ gnyis med rang bzhin phyag rgya chen po'i gnas// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun de rang bzhin// rdo rje 'chang chen dbyer med sa ra ha// klu sgrub yab sras ri khrod rjes 'brangs dang*// bram ze bzang po dpal ldan tog tse pa// dbang phyug mi la dwags po yab sras la// phyag bzang po yis btud de gsung 'di bkod// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdag nyid rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po des// byin gyis brlabs shing de dang gnyis su med pa/ mchog gi byin rlabs kyis tshe 'di nyid la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa ni/"$ bram ze chen po sa ra ha yin te/ bstan pa 'di la rdo rje theg pa'i sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa la snga ba'i grub chen brgyad cu'i spyi mes chen po yin no// de'i brgyud pa 'dzin pa klu sgrub yab sras sam/ ri khrod rje 'bangs sam/ bram ze bzang po'i zhabs sam/ tog tse pa la sogs pa yin te/ de'ang 'dzam bu'i gling na phyag rgya chen po zhes grags shing*// snying po don gyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi brgyud pa'i chu mgo bram ze chen po sa ra ha la ma thug pa med pa yin no// de nyid nas don gyi brgyud pa dang byin brlabs kyi 'pho ba gnyis su med pa'i ye shes chig brgyud zam ma chad pa'i bka' babs shing bcud 'dus pa ni tshe gcig lus gcig la mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar grags pa de nyid yin la/ de'i thugs sras rnams kyi nang nas mchog dang gtso bor gyur cing lung bstan mang du thob pa ni rje dwags po rin po che yin te/ thub pa chen po nyid kyis mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan cing*/ khyad par du ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo dang*/ snying rje padma dkar po'i mdo las gsal bar lung bstan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od gzhon nu/

lnga brgya pa'i dus su tshad med pa'i thugs rjes dge slong 'tsho byed kyi ming can/ 'jig rten gsum du grags pa'i dwags po lha rje zhes bya ba byon nas/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i snying po byin brlabs mngon sum gyi lam/ yi ge med pa'i don gyi brgyud pa gol sa med pa gcig char ba'i lam nas skal ba ldan pa dpag tu med pa khrid cing*/ sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i bdag po lta bu mdzad de/ don gyi brgyud pa ye shes kyi sgron me phyogs bcur spar nas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba dpag tu med pa phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la 'god pa yin no// de'i khrid kyi rim pa ni lhan cig skyes sbyor bya ba yin/ de'i nyams rtogs kyi shan 'byed/ sa lam gyi tshad 'dzin/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i lam gyi rim pa 'di yin/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i chos skad 'di rnams rgyud sde rnams nas tha snyad dngos su gsungs pa yang yod cing*/ don ji lta ba bzhin du bzhugs/ des na rgyud sde'i dgongs don dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje'i thugs rgyud la gcig car du 'khrungs pa/ khyad par gyi chos/ dwags po rin po che'i rtogs chos yin te/ de'i brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i bu chen ri bo lta bu mtha' yas pa byon pas/ dgongs pa bkod lugs kyi bzhed pa mang po zhig byung 'dug de rnams kyi nang nas dbon po dwags po sgom chung la khyad par gyi chos su gnang ba/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i zhal gdams ma bya ba 'di la mthil byas nas/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i yang dgongs don/ 'jig rten mgon po 'bri khung pa dang*// zhang rin po che dang*/ 'gro mgon rgya ras gsum gyi dgongs pa gung srol ba/ rang gi myong ba 'thad ldan phyogs gcig tu sdebs pa'i zhal gdams shig bri bar bya'o// de la dang po phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba de rang gi ngo shes dgos te/ de yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdo rgyud dang*/ sngon gyi grub thob rnams kyi gdams ngag las/

phyag rgya bzhi'i rim pa gsungs te/ phyag rgya gsum la brten nas/ phyag rgya chen po mngon du byed pas/ 'dir de'i khrid kyi rim pa la phyag rgya gsum gyi rim pa don gyis tshang zhing byin rlabs kyi mthus/ thabs khyad par can gyis phyag rgya chen po ngo sprod par mdzad pas/ gcig char ba'i lam yin no// de la phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba/ 'ga' zhig phyag snang ba/ rgya stong pa/ chen po zung 'jug zer te chos kyi phyag rgya'i skad yin/ phyag rgya chen po'i rang skad ma yin/ gsal stong gi skad thams cad dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i skad yin/ bde stong gi skad thams cad las kyi phyag rgya'i skad yin no// phyag rgya chen po ni bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i bzhed kyis/ rkyen gsum dang bral ba/ dga' ba bzhi las 'das pa/ 'od gsal las khyad par du gyur pa gcig bzhed pas/ phyag rgya chen po bde ba'i rkyen la mi ltos/ gsal ba'i rkyen la mi ltos/ mi rtog pa'i rkyen la mi ltos pas rkyen gsum la mi ltos pa'o// dga' ba bzhi las lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ni/ bla mas bstan du yod la/ slob mas go ru yod pas mtshon bya mtshon byed dang bcas pa'i dpe'i ye shes yin/ phyag rgya chen po ni bla mas bstan du med/ slob mas go ru med/ nyams dang myong bas ma sbags/ rtogs pa dang nges shes kyis ma bslad/ lta sgom spyod pas ma phye/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i ris su ma bcad pa'i/ 'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos 'di dag thams cad la bsal bzhag gam/ bcing grol lam/ gnyen pos bzo gcig kyang ma byas pa/ rang sar rang ngo shes shing rang grol ba la phyag rgya chen po zer ba yin no// 'od gsal ni snang med spros bral yin la/ phyag rgya chen po ni snang rig so ma/ spros pa rang grol ba yin pas 'od gsal las khyad par du gyur ba yin no// de la lha sku'am/ 'od gsal lam/ stong pa'am/ bde ba'am/ mi rtog pa la sogs pa'i dmigs gtad dam skyed yod rgyu gcig kyang med par/

lha sku yin mod/ 'dre sku yin mod/ bde ba yin mod/ sdug bsngal yin mod/ snang ba yin mod/ stong pa yin mod/ 'od gsal yin mod/ mtshan ma yin mod/ rtog pa yin mod/ mi rtog pa yin mod/ gang yin yang dgag sgrub gcig kyang ma byas par/ rang sar rang gis chog pa de yin no// de la bsal bzhag gam/ bcos bslad ji ltar byung yang rnam pa yin/ nyams yin/ mtshan ma yin/ dmigs pa yin no// de yang phyag rgya chen po'i sgra don ni/ saṃ kri ta'i skad du ma hā mu dra mu dra'i sgra las drangs na/ mi 'da' ba'am/ mi phyed pa'am/ mi rtog pa la 'jug ste/ de la snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang sa rang sa na so ma nyams/ mdog ma 'gyur gzugs ma brjes par/ dus gsum dus med du lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes las mi 'da' bas phyag rgya/ de las logs sam/ de'i gong na gzhan med pas na chen po'o// de yang shes pa skad cig ma'i thog tu phyogs gcig la sbyar na/ rnam par rtog pa gcig thol skyes pa'i dus na/ rnam rtog de la dgag sgrub gcig kyang ma byas par/ rnam rtog thol le ba de rang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi dngos gzhir 'dug la/ de rtogs rung ma rtogs rung de las mi g.yo mi 'da' bas phyag rgya/ rnam rtog de las logs na/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sam/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa zhes btsal du med pas chen po'o// de ltar yang*/ phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud las/ phyag ni stong pa'i ye shes te// rgya ni 'khor ba'i chos las grol// chen po zung du chud pa ste// phyag rgya chen po zhes brjod do// zhes dang*/ bram ze chen po nyid kyis/ don dam pa yi rig pa la// kye lags dbang po ltos shig dang*// ngas ni 'di las ma rtogs so// rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te// de las gzhan zhig sus kyang rnyed mi 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ dpal ldan tog tse zhabs kyis/ bsam mi khyab las/

mig gi dbang pos bltas pa las// gnyis med ye shes ngo mtshar che// zhes pa la sogs pa'i don yin no// de ltar gang shar rung*/ ji ltar snang rung*/ rtogs rung*/ 'khrul rung gnas rung*/ 'gyus rung*/ ji ltar song yang phyag rgya las 'da' sa med cing*/ chen po las dbul sa med pas/ phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor las yengs su yengs sa med la/ sangs rgyas nas sems can gyi bar gyi snang ba/ tha na mnar med pa'i dmyal ba na bsreg pa'i dus na yang*/ dmyal ba'i snang rig de ka so ma nyams par sku gsum gyi ngo bor krong nge 'dug pas 'khrul du 'khrul sa med cing*/ dngos po'i chos su ma skyes/ dngos med kyi chos su ma 'gags/ tha dad kyi chos la mi gnas/ rtag na rtag thog tu mtha' brgyad rang grol/ chad na chad thog tu mtha' brgyad rang grol te/ gcig mtha' gcig gis bkag pa'i mtha' ye grol la gol du gol sa med/ de ltar rang ngo ma shes par gzung 'dzin la yang dag tu zhen pas/ yengs pa'am/ 'khrul pa'am/ gol sa la sogs pa thams cad kun brtags kyi blo ngo yin no// yid la mi byed pa zhes pa'i don ni/ sang kri ta'i skad du/ a ma na si si ka ra zhes bya ste/ yi ge bdun po 'di'i sgra las drangs na/ a ma na yid/ si si ka ra byed pa yin la/ de a yis bkag pas/ de ltar na yid la byed pa med pa zhes bya ste/ yid la mi gnas pa'am/ yid las grol ba'am/ yid las 'das pa zhes pa la 'jug la/ de yid la mi gnas pa zhes bsgyur na sgra don go bde ba la/ yid la mi byed pa la 'khrul gzhi byung nas/ yid kyis yul byas/ rnam rtog dang kun rtog gis yul can byas nas/ de gnyis kyis de yid la mi byed pa la/ yid la mi byed pa ltar go nas/ yid la mi byed pa rang yid la byed par song ba yang 'dug go /'di'i don ni/ kun gzhi dang sgo lngar ji ltar shar yang rtog med du rang gsal ba phyag rgya chen po'i rang gshis yin no// de la nyon mongs pa can gyi yid kyis kun gzhi la kha nang du bltas te bdag tu bzung*/

yid shes kyis sgo lnga la phyi ru bltas te ris su bcad/ de ltar yid gnyis kyi gzung 'dzin ni 'khor ba'i chos te bzang ngan gyi 'dzin pa thams cad yid yin la/ de las 'das shing mi gnas pas phyag rgya chen po yin no// de yang lta ba zung 'jug gam/ mnyam nyid dam/ phyogs med dam/ snang stong dbyer med la sogs pa ji tsam zad sar skyol zhing mtha' dang bral ba/ mthon po dang chen por ming ji ltar btags kyang*/ rnam dpyad dang yongs dpyod kyi phyogs 'dzin spu rtse tsam zhig 'dug na yid byed kyi lta ba yin/ phyag rgya chen po ma yin/ sgom pa'i khyad par blo 'das sam/ dmigs med dam/ rtsa bral lam/ zang thal la sogs pa ji ltar bzang zhing yangs par ming btags kyang*/ myong ba'am/ nges shes kyi gtad so spu rtse tsam zhig 'dug na yid byed kyi sgom pa yin/ phyag rgya chen po ma yin/ da ltar gyi snang rig so ma 'di la chos sku'am/ ye shes sam/ bde chen nam/ bsal bzhag gam/ bral thob kyi gnyen pos/ bcos rgyu'am/ spang rgyu'am/ 'dag rgyu'am/ thob rgyu'am/ skyed dbyung rgyu spu rtse tsam zhig 'dug na yang yid byed kyi spyod pa yin/ yid byed kyi 'bras bu yin/ phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa ma yin/ mai tri pas/ sems nyid ma bcos chos kyi sku// snang ba bde chen longs spyod rdzogs// 'gro 'ong sems can sprul pa'i bdag /dam pa dag las rtogs pa'o// zhes dang*/ stug po bkod pa las/ sems nyid bde stong lhan cig skyes// 'og min gtsang ma'i gnas mchog go /zhes pa ltar/ 'di ni sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pas don thun mong ma yin pa gtan la 'bebs pa ste/ de rnams las 'das shing mi gnas pa la phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba 'dzin cing 'dod na yang phyag rgya chen po ma yin no// smra tshad phyogs 'dzin/ bsam tshad rtog pa yin pas/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'am/ zab pa'am/ dben pa'i don zhes pa las/

phyogs gcig tu 'di yin zhes gsung du ma btub pas tshig gi lam chad pa yin no// mdor na tha mal gyi shes pa sus kyang bzo ma byas pa'i aṃ so re ba 'di/ kho rang gis kho rang ngo shes pa de la phyag rgya chen po'i dge sbyor skyes pa zer ba yin no// 'di la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes byas na chos skad yin/ tha mal gyi shes pa rjen pa byas na ku su lu'i blun gtam yin/ don la 'dra ba yin no// de ltar phyag rgya chen po'i rang ngo de rig thog tu rdo rus shig ma thug na/ nyams rtogs kyi dbye ba dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa la sogs pa'i bshad shod ji ltar byas kyang*/ go yul ban bun las sa zin dang*/ bzhag sa mi yong bas/ bla ma rtogs ldan gcig gi drung du mos gus kyi snying phur btab la/ byin rlabs kyi 'pho bas don gyi chig brgyud thob par bya'o// phyag rgya chen po na btub/ 'chi btub/ skyid btub/ sdug btub/ dran btub/ yengs btub cig med na/ gzhan ci yod kyang sgom chen de phyi ldir nang stong*/ khang stong sgo lcags can bya ba yin no// nyams dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bye brag skyed cing sgom du ngo sprod pa'i bla ma ni mang la/ tha mal gyi shes pa sgom du ngo sprod shes pa'i bla ma ni nyin khar gyi skar ma bas dkon pa yin no// 'di'i skabs su dpal phag mo gru pas rje dwags po rin po che'i drung du nyams phul zhing ngo sprad pa dang*/ rje 'bri khung pas dpal phag mo gru pa'i drung du sngar gyi phyag rgya chen po'i sgom lugs dang nyams phul zhing ngo sprad pa dang*/ bla ma zhang gis dwags po sgom tshul la khrid bskyangs pa dang*/ bla ma ri shi ras pa la bla ma 'ba' rong pas bslabs pa'i sgom bla ma zhang can byon pa'i dus su bshig nas ngo sprad pa dang*/ 'gro mgon rgya ras kyis rje btsun gling gi drung du khrid bskyangs pa'i lo rgyus rnams gsungs te lo rgyus de rnams rang la go rgyu re yod pa yin no// de lta bu'i phyag rgya chen po de bla ma nyams rtogs can gcig gis khrid kyi skya dbar nas bton pas/

shor sa bzhi dang*/ gol sa gsum du ma shor bar bskyangs pa na/ skye lugs gsum gyis mtshams sbyar nas/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pas skye bar gsungs/ de la dang po shor sa bzhi ni/ stong nyid shes bya gshis la shor ba/ stong nyid lam du shor ba/ stong nyid gnyen por shor ba/ stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba'o// 'di la ye shor dang*/ 'phral shor gnyis yin gsungs/ ye shor ni don spyi go yul du shor ba yin la/ 'phral shor ni nyams myong ngam lag len 'khrul pa yin no// de la ye shor bzhi'i stong nyid shes bya gshis la shor ba ni/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa gnyis med rten 'brel gyi 'dug lugs ma go bar/ stong pa bya ba med pa/ ma grub pa gcig la blo rtse gtad nas/ mtshan nyid pas/ snang ba 'di gtan tshigs chen po bzhi'i sgo nas brtags nas/ ci yang ma grub pa la gshis byed pa'am/ gsang sngags pas/ swa bhā wa dang*/ shu n+ya tās/ snang dmigs kyi dngos po thams cad stong par sbyangs nas/ med pa'am/ ma grub pa la gshis byed pa lta bu/ stong nyid du blos bzo byed pa de/ stong nyid gshis la shor ba'o// lam du shor ba ni rgyu 'bras dbyer med kyi don lam gsal byed kyi rkyen dang 'bras bu bral ba'i 'bras bur ma go bar/ da lta stong nyid lam du byas shing bsgoms pas/ des 'bras bu chos sku thob par 'dod pa'o// gnyen por shor ba ni/ sbang bya rang gi gshis dus gsum du stong nyid du gnas pa'i spang bya gnyen po dbyer med pa de rang ngo ma shes shing*/ spang bya kho rang gi gnyen por kho rang 'char ba ma go bar/ nyon mongs logs pa zhig la stong nyid logs pa zhig gis spang bya gnyen pos spang ba ni/ gnyen por shor ba'o/ rgyas 'debs su shor ba ni/ thabs shes zung 'jug zab rgyas dbyer med kyi don ma go bar/ sbyin pa'am/ bsngo ba lta bu/ sngon la 'khor gsum dmigs pa can gcig byas pa la/ de nas 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i rgyas 'debs pa ni/

dang po thabs rkyang pa/ 'og ma shes rab rkyang par song bas/ bden gnyis lam du mi slong shing*/ don gnyis mngon du mi byed pas rgyas 'debs su shor ba'o// 'phral shor bzhi ni/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa de yang*/ bla ma gdams ngag zab mo can gyi bdag rkyen dang rang gi shes rab chen po'i nyer len gyis/ don spyi ji lta ba bzhin blo yul du go zhing gzhan la smra shes kyang ga shed na su zhig la yod pa zhig gtan la 'bebs pa lta bur song nas rig thog tu ngo ma 'phrod cing thug rig med pa ni/ stong nyid gshis la shor ba'o// rtogs pa nyag nyug skyes kyang 'dzin med du thag ma chod cing*/ ltos med du blo ma khel ba de bas lhag par zhig yod par re nas/ tha mal gyi shes pas blo ma tshim par sgom gyi lhan pa btab cing bsgom pa ni/ lam du shor ba'o// rnam rtog 'gyus pa'i dus su yang*/ rang sar rang ngo shes pa'i yang dag gi dran pa bsten mi shes par/ 'gyus pa bkug cing sgom la 'jog pa ni/ gnyen por shor ba'o// rgyas 'debs su shor ba la gnyis las/ dred po rgyas 'debs su shor ba ni/ sgom mgo rkang ma tshang ba'am/ bdag po med par shor bas dang po bsgom dga' rab skyes kyang*/ phyis yid yul du dreng tsam las med pa de la/ phyis snyogs su yid dga' byas shing dmigs med yin/ mi rtog pa yin snyam du gsal 'debs pa'o// blo chung rgyas 'debs su shor ba ni/ rjes thob lam du mi slongs par/ a pha da ci nas yengs 'dug da bsgom dgos snyam du rnam rtog gi bre kha sgom gyis gcod pa'o// de bzhir ma shor bar byed pa ni/ gong gi phyag rgya chen po de don spyi ma nor ba go zhing*/ rang mtshan ma 'khrul bar rtogs na mi 'chor te/ de yang rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa/ yod pas stong*/ med pas stong*/ rtag pas stong*/ chad pas stong*/ snang bas stong*/ stong pas stong*/ dngos pos stong*/

dngos med kyis stong pas/ gshis ci yang ma yin pa/ rkyen gyis ci yang byar btub cing*/ gshis don dam du bden par med pa la/ gdangs kun rdzob tu brdzun par med pa'i gnyis med rten 'brel du go bas stong nyid gshis la mi 'chor/ gang shar gyi snang rig so ma 'di la/ spang thob kyi bogs dbyung rgyu med pa'i rgyu 'bras dbyer med kyi don shes pas/ stong nyid lam du mi 'chor/ lam snying po'i rang 'gros spang gnyen gnyis su med pa'i zag med kyi sdom pa rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi don shes pas/ stong nyid gnyen por mi 'chor/ mtshan ma'am/ dmigs bcas kyi dge ba ji ltar byas kyang*/ de'i gshis dmigs med las 'da' sa med pas/ 'khor gsum rang gi ngo bos stong pas gang zag gis rgyas btab mi dgos par/ chos kyis rgyas ye btab tu shes pas stong nyid rgyas 'debs su mi 'chor ba'o// gol sa gsum ni/ bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum ste/ bde ba la zhen pa yod/ gsal ba la 'dzin pa yod/ mi rtog pa la blos byas yod pas/ de gsum la zhen na khams gsum la gol zhing*/ zhen 'dzin med kyang gnas lugs kyi rang zhal ma mthong na/ nyan rang gi 'bras bur gol lo// phyag rgya chen po ni/ rkyen gsum dang bral ba'i tha mal gyi shes pa rjen pa yin pa'i phyir/ do ha las/ bsam gtan brdzun pas thar pa thob bam ci// kye lags gang smras brdzun par song ba de bor la// gang la zhen pa yod pa de yang thong*/ zhes pa'i don no// spyir zhi gnas kyi bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum gyis mtshams phyed dgos kyi/ rnam pa nas rnam par gol sar byas pas mi 'ong*/ rtogs pa'i bde gsal mi rtog pas sku gsum mngon du byed pa yid no// de ltar shor sa bzhi dang*/ gol sa gsum du ma shor bar nyams su blangs pas skye lugs gsum ni/ gcig char du skye ba/ rim gyis skye ba/ thod rgal du skye ba'o// de la gcig char ba ni/

dper na/ gcong rong dog mo'i lung pa skam gsher med pa'i nam mkha' las nyi ma shar ba'i dus su/ nyi rgan de shar ma thag tu/ mun pa sangs pa dang*/ sa rdo dros pa/ 'khyag pa zhu ba gsum dus mnyam du 'byung ba dang 'dra bar/ bla ma bcud ldan gcig la/ slob ma snod ldan gcig gis/ mos gus tshad med cig gnad du bsnun pa'i dus su/ byin rlabs kyi 'pho ba don gyi chig brgyud thob ste/ gnas pa/ nyams myong rtogs pa gsum sgom pa po med par dus gcig char la shar nas/ skad cig la sgom med kyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa ni/ gcig char ba'i skye lugs te/ dwags po rin po che'am/ rje btsun gling ras pa lta bu'o// rim gyis pa'i skye lugs ni/ gnam kha zheng can gyi ze zur gyi nyi ma'am/ yul ngan gyi nyi ma kha shor dang 'dra ste/ nyi ma shar nas mun pa rags pa sangs pa tsam 'dug kyang sa rdo mi dros shing*/ 'khyag pa 'ju bar mi nus pa bzhin/ gnas pa/ nyams myong*/ rtogs pa gsum rim gyi nud tsam nud tsam du skye zhing*/ sems kyi ngo bo tsam mthong yang*/ 'phral du spang bya mi spangs shing*/ gnyen po la dbang ma thob pas sgom gnyug bsring dgos pa yin no// thod rgal ba'i skye lugs ni/ sprin bar gyi nyi ma dang 'dra ste/ sngon la rtogs pa lhag gis 'char/ rtogs kyang mi brtan/ mtho dma' dang gsal 'grib shin tu che/ ras nyams su 'char/ res a 'thas su 'ong*/ res rtogs pa rjen 'ong ste/ skye lugs 'di nyams len zhen pa'am/ sgom yun chung bas tshe 'dir gcig char bar ma 'phrod na/ 'di'i rtogs pa bsha' ma bar dor 'char ba yin gsungs so// de la rim gyis pa lam ma rdzogs pa yin/ thod rgal ba lam mi brtan pa yin/ gcig char ba lam mchog yin no// des na/ rim gyis pa'i skye lugs kyi dbang du byas na/ gnas pa/ nyams myong*/ rtogs pa gsum rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pas skye ba ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu tshogs pa las/

gnas pa gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin skye ste/ gnas pa dang po ri gzar gyi kha nas chu 'bab pa dang 'dra ste/ rnam rtog sngar bas kyang rags shing mang ba zam ma chad pa 'byung*/ de'i dus su bla ma nyams myong can med na sgom chen mgo 'khor zhing*/ sna sun nas 'gro ba yin/ de ltar rnam rtog byung tshad tshor ba de/ sems cung zad zin pa yin pas gnas pa'i nyams yin/ gnas pa med pa'i gong du rnam rtog ngos ma zin pas rgya yan du shor ba'o// de'i sna ma bskyil rjes su ma 'brangs par bskyangs pas/ ji zhig ltar la rnam rtog de phra nyal song nas mi rtog pa'i ngang ma shor bar/ rnam rtog phra mo tol skyes kyang*/ rtog pa'i bya ba mi byed par gtad med du yal 'gro ba de/ gnas pa bar pa chu klung dal gyis 'bab pa lta bu yin/ de nas rnam rtog gi 'gyu ba chad nas mi rtog pa'i ngang la gang bzhag bzhag gnas pa de/ gnas pa tha ma mi g.yo ba rgya mtsho lta bu bya ba yin/ bka' gdams pa kun de la bsgom du byed pa yod par gda'/ de ltar gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin de zhen pa med par thabs la mkhas shing shes rab kyis zin par bskyangs pas/ rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor skye ste/ rnal 'byor zhes pa ni/ thabs dang shes rab bam zhi gnas dang lhag mthong mnyam par sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor te/ de gang gis sbyor ba nus pa de la rnal 'byor pa bya ba yin/ de la rnal 'byor bzhi'i sa mtshams zhib tu phye na/ rje dwags po sgom chung gi zhal gdams las/ dang po ngo ti ngos bzung ba bzhi ni/ ngang la gnas pa rtse gcig yin// sgro 'dogs chod pa spros bral yin// spang blang med pa ro gcig yin// myong ba dag pa sgom med yin/ mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa bzhi ni/ rtse gcig dus su ngo bo rtogs// spros bral dus su rang bzhin rtogs// ro gcig dus su mtshan nyid rtogs// sgom med rtogs pa khor yug ma'o// rtogs pa'i 'khor sa bzhi ni// rtse gcig mun pa'i dkyil na 'byams// spros bral med pa'i stong rdzis khyer// ro gcig 'dres pa'i rba la g.yengs// sgom med nyi ma sprin gyis bkag

/rjes shes kyi skye tshul bzhi ni/ rtse gcig gi rjes shes a 'thas su skye/ spros bral gyi rjes shes sgyu mar skye/ ro gcig gi rjes shes stong par skye/ sgom med kyi rjes shes snying rjer skye// rjes kyi dri ma bzhi la/ rtse gcig la dngos 'dzin gyi dri ma/ spros bral la ngo ma shes kyi dri ma/ ro gcig la nyams kyi dri ma/ sgom med la shes bya'i dri ma'o// rjes shes 'dag tshul bzhi la/ rtse gcig la bral ba yod la thob pa med// spros bral la bral thob gnyis ka yod// ro gcig la bral ba med la thob pa yod// sgom med la bral thob gnyis ka med do// mnyam rjes kyi sa mtshams bzhi la/ rtse gcig man chad la mnyam rjes mtshan nyid pa med/ rang sa'i mnyam rjes yod/ de'i don gyis rjes snang 'ba' zhig yin/ spros bral gyi dus su mnyam rjes shags kyis dbye/ ro gcig gi dus su mnyam rjes 'dre/ sgom med kyi dus su mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig yin/ yang rtse gcig a 'thas su sgom pa'i dus/ spros bral stong par sgom pa'i dus/ ro gcig zung 'jug sgom pa'i dus/ sgom med mngon du gyur pa'i dus so// de la mnyam bzhag phung po lnga bral gyi rtogs pa rjes shes/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi snang ba 'dag lugs ni/ rtse gcig dus su gzugs kyi phung po dang bral sgo lnga'i rnam shes 'dag spros bral gyi dus su tshor ba'i phung po 'du shes kyi phung po dang bral/ yid kyi rnam shes 'dag ro gcig gi dus su 'du byed kyi phung po dang bral/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid 'dag sgom med kyi dus su rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang bral/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa 'dag pa yin no// nyams rtogs kyi sa mtshams bzhi la/ rtse gcig nyams rtogs dri bcas/ spros bral nyams rtogs shan 'byed/ ro gcig nyams rtogs zung 'jug sgom med rtogs pa khor yug ma'o// kun rdzob rgyu 'bras kyi 'khyer tshul bzhi la/

rtse gcig dus su a 'thas kyi rgyu 'bras/ spros bral dus su sgyu ma lta bu'i rgyu 'bras/ ro gcig dus su nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras/ sgom med dus su gzhi med rten cing 'brel 'byung mkhyen pa'o/ go ba nyams myong rtogs pa gsum gyi khyad par ni/ don spyi ma nor ba blo yul du shar ba go ba/ rang mtshan gyi rnam pa nyams 'og tu tshud pa nyams myong*/ rang mtshan ma 'khrul bar mngon sum rtogs pa ni rtogs pa/ yang blo yul du yid ches pa go ba// de sems kyis myong ba nyams/ sems rang de'i ngo bo shar ba rtogs pa'o// de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi po de la/ rje phag mo gru pa'i/ rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis su phye ba ni/ rtse gcig chung ngu bde gsal gyi ngo bo mthong*/ 'bring po ting nge 'dzin la rang dbang thob/ chen po nyams kyi khor yug tu song ba'o// spros bral chung ngu skye 'gag med par rtogs/ 'bring po rtsa ba bral bar rtogs/ chen po phyi nang gi chos la sgro 'dogs chod pa'o// ro gcig chung ngu 'khor 'das gcig tu 'dres/ 'bring po gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba rbad kyis chod/ chen po chos thams cad mnyam pa'i nyid kyi ngang du zhi ba'o// sgom med chung ngu bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral/ 'bring po lhun grub kyis rang sa zin/ chen po 'od gsal gnyis 'dres pa'o// de rnams la/ 'gro mgon rgya ras kyis bzhed kyi/ ngo bo mthong ma mthong*/ rtsal rdzogs ma rdzogs/ rnam rtog sgom du shar ma shar/ yon tan rgyud la skyes ma skyes/ kun rdzob la rang byan tshud ma tshud// gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs ma thebs dang drug gis phra zhib 'byed pa'o// de rnams kyi don rgyas par bshad na/ dang po ngang la gnas pa rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor te/ de yang gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni zhi gnas rkyang pa yin la/ 'dir rnal 'byor zhes pa zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'brel dgos te/ phra rags kyi rnam rtog rang sar zhi nas sems gsal stong nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil lta bu sal le seng nge gnas pa la rtog med du nges shes skyes pa ni lhag mthong gi nyams yin pas zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i sgom mo// sgom de bzang dus na rtog med kyi shes pa bde gsal du seng nge rjen ne ye re lhang nge gnas pa ni/

bde gsal du gnas pa'i ngo bo mthong ba'o// rjes thob tu res bsgoms kyang mi 'ong*/ res ma bsgoms kyang 'ong ba ni/ ting nge 'dzin la dbang ma thob pas/ bzo gsar bza' mi btub pa dang 'dra bas rtse gcig chung ngu yin no// phyag rgya chen po'i sgom gyi sna 'di nas zin pa yin pas/ bla ma nyams myong can gyis ngo sprad 'dod pa yin/ de la sgom skyes pa zer ba lags so// de brtan pas rtog med kyi shes pa ngos bzung med par sing nge ba de la nam bzhag bzhag gis gnas pa na/ rtse gcig 'bring po ting nge 'dzin la rang dbang thob pa bya ba yin/ de rgyun chad med par shar nas/ rnam rtog thams cad de'i ngang du zhi/ gnyid kyang nyams kyi 'od gsal du tshud spyod lam rnam bzhir 'bral ba med pa na/ rtse gcig chen po nyams kyi khor yug ma bya ba yin/ 'di'i dus su sgom med yin nam snyam pa'i nges shes chen po 'ong ste/ nyams rtogs par shor ba bya ba'i gol sa yin/ phyogs re'i rtogs pa dang sbyar na/ zhang rin po che'i zhal nas/ rtse gcig dus su ngo bo rtogs gsungs/ ngo bo gsal la go ma 'gags pa'i shes pa nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil lta bu de la yid ches shing*/ rtog med du nges shes skyes pa na/ rtse gcig gi ngo bo mthong*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang la sa le seng nge gnas pa tsam 'dug kyang yid ches kyi nges shes ma skyes na/ lhag mthong gi nyams dang ma 'brel/ gnas lugs dang zhal ma mjal bas/ rtse gcig mun pa'i dkyil na 'byams pa zhes bya ba ngo bo ma mthong ba yin/ sems rang ngo ma shes pas nyams rtogs kyi sa mtshams ma phyed de/ snang la ma nges pa'i nyams bu chung gis zla ba mthong ba'am/ blun pos lha khang mthong ba lta bu'o// nges shes yul 'dzin dang bcas pas nyams rtogs dri ma can yin/ rtse gcig man chad la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes ma skyes pas/ mnyam bzhag mtshan nyid pa med la/ rjes snang sgyu mar mi 'char bas rjes thob mtshan nyid pa med/

rang sa'i mnyam rjes yod/ sems gsal stong rtog med du gnas kyang*/ yul 'dzin gyi yid byed ma dag pas mnyam bzhag btags pa ba yin/ rjes shes dngos 'dzin a 'thas su skye bas/ mi la khyi rjes byung ba dang 'dra ste rjes thob btags pa ba yin/ mnyam bzhag bde gsal rtog med kyi sgom la nam bzhag bzhag gis gnas pa na rtse gcig gi rtsal rdzogs/ res bsgoms kyang mi 'ong*/ res ma bsgoms kyang 'ong na/ da dung rtsal ma rdzogs/ rnam rtog skyes tshad dran pa tsam gyis sgom de'i ngang du zhi/ gnyid nyams kyi 'od gsal tshud pa na/ rnam rtog sgom du shar/ dran pas rnam rtog zhi mi nus par sgom lcags kyu mas 'gyus dran bkug cing sgom la bzhag dgos na/ rnam rtog sgom du ma shar/ dran pas ma zin na sgom 'chor bas bral ba yod la/ zin kyang sngar gyi sgom gyi rgyun de la bzhag pa las/ rnam rtog gi ngo bo ma mthong bas thob pa med sgom de bskyangs yun ring na chos brgyad las blo ldog phyi nang gi srin bu spong*/ mngon shes dang zad par zil gnon la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul ci rigs pa ston nus na/ rtse gcig gi yon tan skyes pa yin/ sems las su mi rung zhing*/ yid zhi ba ma thob na sgom gyi dwangs snyigs ma phyed par thun mong gi drod rtags 'byin mi nus na/ yon tan ma skyes pa yin/ ting nge 'dzin dwangs pa'i 'char sgo la phyi nang gi rgyu 'bras phra rags la khrig tshud pas/ bskyed bya skyed byed kyi a 'thas kyi rgyu 'bras go na/ kun rdzob la rang byan tshud pa yin/ zag bcas 'jig rten pa'i lam yin/ las rang rgyud pa sogs bag chags 'brel ma chod/ stong cha mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin yod kyang*/ snang cha'i rten 'brel la go ba ma skyes na/ kun rdzob la byan ma tshud/ sgom de'i gdangs la sems rnam rtog sna tshogs kyis dub pa'i sems can la dmigs bcas kyi snying rje'i gdung shugs skyes na/

gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs pa yin/ rang sa'i 'gro la phan pa 'byung*/ nyams kyi tshan khas snying rje'i skye sgo 'gags na/ gzhan don gyi sa bon ma thebs te nyan thos 'gog pa dang 'dra'o// de ltar rtse gcig gi nyams de zhen pa med par bskyangs pas/ nyams myong de rnam par dag pa'i ngang du ji zhig ltar la/ spros bral chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong 'ong ste/ gang mthong na rang mthong*/ gang gis mthong na rang gis mthong*/ ji ltar mthong na yul dang yul can gnyis su med pa mthong ngo*// de yang 'das pa'i shes pa rgyun chad/ ma 'ongs pa'i shes pa ma skyes pa'i bar na/ da ltar gyi shes pa rnam rtog skad cig ma/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngo bo/ kho rang gis kho rang yul med du rang ngo shes pa'o// 'di'i dus su 'khor 'das kyi sa mtshams phyed/ sngar gyi go ba dang chos skad// nyams myong gi bzang 'dzin thams cad phyi shun ltar 'gro/ sems kho rang phyi ru bltas spros pa dang bral/ nang du bltas spros pa dang bral/ spros bral gyi ngo bo mthong bas ngos bzung ma grub/ tha snyad kyi gtad so ma rnyed/ blo'i yul du byar ma btub par yul med du rang ngo shes shing rtog med du sgro 'dogs chod pa de spros bral gyi ngo bo mthong ba yin no// de yang sdud pa las/ gzugs rnams mi mthong tshor ba dag kyang mi mthong zhing*// 'du shes mthong ba med la sems pa mi mthong ste// gang la rnam par shes dang sems yid mthong med pa// 'di ni chos mthong yin zhes 'dren pas rab tu bshad// mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis ni bsnyad par nus ma yin// nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod kyang*// nam mkha' ji ltar mthong ba'i don 'di bsam par gyis// de ltar chos mthong ba'ang de bzhin gshegs pas bstan// ces pa'i don ni/ de ltar sgom gyi go ra nas thon pa'i tha mal du khres se ba'i rtogs pa de/ phung po lnga dang bral ba yin te/

dngos po'i ngo bo ma grub pas gzugs kyi phung po dang bral/ myong rig gi 'dzin pa dag pas tshor ba'i phung po dang bral/ tha snyad kyi gtad so med pas 'du shes kyi phung po dang bral/ kun sbyor gyi sems pa med pas 'du byed kyi phung po dang bral/ nges shes kyi yul 'dzin dag pas rnam shes kyi phung po dang bral ba ste/ phung po lnga bral gyi rtogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i lam gyi mngon sum gyis grub pa yin te/ don yod zhags pa'i mdo las/ phung po lnga dang bral ba'i sbyor ba 'dis ni/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran par bya'o// zhes pa'i don no// de ltar gsal stong gi ngo bo mthong yang*/ stong 'dzin nam nges shes kyi 'khris shig dang ma bral bar 'dug na/ nyams rtogs kyi shan ma phyed pas spros bral chung ngu yin/ de'i dus su sems skye 'gag dang bral bar rtogs te/ tha mal gyi shes pa rjen pa rnam rtog bag chags kyi 'char sgo/ bkra hrig ge ba'i rig stong 'gyu stong*/ dngos po'i chos su ma skyes/ dngos med kyi phyogs su mi 'gag tha dad kyi chos su mi gnas pas/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba rnam thar sgo gsum gyi don mthong*/ yid byed kyi mi dge ba med pas dge sbyor skyes pa zer zag med kyi lam du tshud pas mthong lam dngos yin/ rtogs pa de brtan por song ba dang*/ stong 'dzin nges shes kyi cha nyams kyi dri ma de rtsa ba nas dag nas/ tha mal gyi shes pa yul med du lhung song ste/ snang 'dzin stong 'dzin gzhi rtsa bral bas na/ spros bral 'bring po rtsa ba bral bar rtogs pa yin/ do ha las/ rtsa ba bral bar gang gis sus shes pa// bla ma'i bka' drin thob pa de yi mchog /ces so// 'di'i skabs su rtog pa'i rang bzhin shes pas/ 'gyu thog tu bde la/ snang thog tu bde dog gi 'dzin pa 'byung ba yin/ 'di nas nyams rtogs kyi shan phyed/ rtogs pa nyams dang 'dres shing*/

nyams rtogs pa dang ma bral bar nyams kyi 'dag byed rtogs pas byas/ rtogs pa'i mgo nyams kyis bton nas bskyangs pas/ rtogs pa de mthar thug pa na/ 'khor 'das lam gyi bsdus pa shes bya la srid tshad kyi phyi nang gi chos la/ spros pa dang ma bral ba'am mi stong pa skra'i rtse mo tsam yang med par/ mtshan ma'i spros pa dang bral zhing*/ 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs chod pa ni/ spros bral chen po phyi nang gi chos la sgro 'dogs chod pa'o// 'di'i dus su/ snang thog tu snang ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pas snang ba bdag med tu 'char/ snang ba rang sems don spyi'i tshul du rtogs pa yin pas/ phyi rol na snang ba med par rang gi sems su rtogs pas sems tsam pa dang mthun zhes pa'i don yang de yin/ spros bral byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rtogs pas stong thog tu sgro 'dogs chod/ don dam pa'i shes rab yin pas/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'am/ ma skyes pa'am/ ma grub pa gcig bde/ gang shar gyi rnam rtog so ma nyams pa 'di cung mi bde bas/ phyag rgya chen po'i phyogs gcig las ma rtogs/ ro gcig skyes pa dang spros pa dang bral ma bral med/ stong mi stong med par snang ba so ma/ ci skyes gang shar gang snang gis chog pa ste/ phyag rgya chen po mtshan nyid pa da gzod rtogs pa yin/ spros bral du 'od gsal rtogs pa yin/ ro gcig tu zung 'jug rtogs pa yin/ rtogs pa la na 'phar rgyu zhig gda'o/ rje 'bri khung pas/ snga ma'i rtogs pa de phyi ma'i 'dag rgyu yin yang gsungs/ skad cig gis skye 'gag byed pa yang spang bya dang gnyen po 'phel 'grib byed pa yin no// spros bral skyes pa dang mnyam rjes gnyis su shags kyis 'byed de/ sems phyi nang med par ye shes zang thal du shar ba la mtshan ma'i spros pa med pa yul med du rang ngo shes pa de rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes zhes bya ste/ mnyam bzhag mtshan nyid pa yin/

rjes shes yul yul can du song yang*/ snang ba la bden 'dzin med par sgyu mar skye ste/ mi shul du mi rjes byung ba dang 'dra ste/ rjes thob mtshan nyid pa yin/ de la snang la ma nges pa'i ngo mi shes kyi dri ma yod/ yang dag gi dran pas ma zin na bral ba dang*/ zin tsam na gang shar gyi rang ngo mthong bas thob yod de/ ye shes kyi 'gro ldog byed pas bral thob gnyis ka yod/ de ltar rtog med kyi shes pa yul med du gsal ba ni mnyam bzhag rang ngo ma shes par yul snang gi rtog par thal shar ba na rjes shes/ de nyid du ngo shes kyi dran pas rang sar rang ngo mthong ba ni rjes thob/ de'i rgyun gzung 'dzin gyi mtha' la mi gnas par rang so tshugs pa mnyam bzhag ste/ de lta bu'i mnyam rjes kyi nyams len khor yug gis sgom spang gi dri ma spong ba yin no// de la sems skad cig ma'i rang ngo spros bral du mthong ba la/ nges shes kyi 'dzin pa dag pa spros bral du rtogs pa na ngo bo mthong ba yin/ de la stong 'dzin nam nges shes kyi cha thams cad spros bral gyi nyams yin/ spros bral du rtogs kyang yul yul can gyi cha bag tsam 'dug na ngo bo ma mthong*/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad spros bral du rang ngo shes pas 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs chod pa spros bral du dag pa na/ spros bral gyi rtsal rdzogs pa yin/ rnam rtog gi rang bzhin shes kyang snang thog tu bde dog 'ong ba dang*/ ngo bo mthong yang stong 'dzin gyi myong ba ma dag na rtsal ma rdzogs/ gang shar gyi dran snang stong snang dang stong 'gyu ru rang ngo shes na rnam rtog sgom du shar/ mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa rjes snang gi thog tu lam du mi slongs/ nyin bar gyi dge sbyor gnyid kyi dus su mi 'drongs na/ sgom res 'jog ma ste rnam rtog sgom du ma shar/ mthong lam gyi yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i cha mthun shar na yon tan skyes pa yin/

rtogs pa chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong yang sang byed lam gyi rkyen dang ma 'phrad par grub pa'i rtags kyi snang cha med na yon tan ma skyes/ stong pa'i gdangs rgyu 'bras su rtogs pas/ gshis ci yang ma yin la/ rkyen gyis cir yang byar btub pa'i rten 'brel/ chos thams cad tshogs pa las 'byung ba/ rkyen las skye ba/ sgyu ma lta bu'i rgyu 'bras/ snang sems sgyu ma'i 'char sgor go na/ kun rdzob la byan tshud pa yin/ de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa ma sangs na/ las 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa ma sangs pas rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel ma go na byan ma tshud pa yin/ 'di'i skabs su rgyu 'bras stong par rtogs pas rnam smin la bsags pa mi 'dug las 'bras la grub pa mi 'dug snyam pa'i myong ba'i nges shes kyi rtogs pa de'i rjes su 'breng na/ nag po kha 'byams su shor dogs yod/ spros bral med pa'i stong rdzis khyer bya ba'i 'khor sa yin/ bdud kyi bar chad sdom pa shor ba la sogs pa 'byung*/ las rjes su mi 'brang*/ las kyi dbang du mi 'chor/ ltar snang tsam du smin/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i gdangs dmigs med kyi snying rjer skye/ snying rje'i smon lam gyi 'phrul 'khor gyis rjes shes kyi snang ba la/ legs tshogs kyi rten 'brel bden med du sgrig shes na/ gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs/ gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig stong nyid rtogs kyang snying rje ma skyes pa'am/ shes rab rgyud la skyes kyang thabs kyi rim pa khyad du gsod na gzugs sku'i sa bon ma thebs/ gzhan don 'grub par dka'/ gzhan don pas lto rgyab kyang phyed dka'o// spyir gang zag gi rigs ma nges te sngon gyi sbyang ba che chung gis/ la la spros bral dang po nas dran pas bzung mi dgos pa 'ong*/ la la ro gcig chen po'i bar du dran pas bzung dgos pa 'ong*/ la la stong nyid rtogs kyang snying rje ma skyes pa'am/

la la rtogs pa dang snying rje dus mnyam du 'char ba 'ong*/ nyams rtogs zung du chud ma chud/ thabs shes ya bral ma bral mtha' gcig tu 'ong bar ma nges so// spyod pa la yang*/ la la ci byas kyang mi lto snyam nas 'jig rten pa dang 'dre ba 'ong*/ la la ri khrod 'grim zhing sgrub pa byed/ la la sangs rgyas kyi bya ba rlabs po che la 'jug ste/ ma nges pa yin no// de ltar spros bral gyi rtogs pa de bskyangs pa las/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la spros bral ma bral med/ stong mi stong med/ bsal bzhag dang dgag sgrub med par rang sar grol ba rang ngo shes pas/ snang ba du mar snang yang*/ rtogs pa gcig gi ngo bor du ma ro gcig gi rnal 'byor te/ de la ro gcig chung ngu 'khor 'das gcig tu 'dre ba ni/ snang ba stong pa don dam kun rdzob/ skyed rim rdzogs rim la sogs pa gnyis bsdus kyi chos ji snyed pa de thams cad/ rtogs pa gcig gi ngo bor dbyer med par zung 'jug mngon du gyur/ snang ba stong pa dang 'bral ma myong la stong pa snang ba dang 'bral ma myong bas/ snang stong gang rung re'i thog na/ lam gyi chos ji snyed pa thams cad tshang zhing gnyis med zung du 'jug pa yin pas/ zung 'jug yangs pa yin/ de ltar du ma ro gcig tu rtogs kyang*/ da dung de rang la 'dzin pa'am/ nges shes kyi cha ma 'dres pa'am/ 'dres pa'i myong ba nges shes kyi dri ma cung zad cig 'dug na ro gcig chung ngu*/ ro gcig 'bring po gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba rbad kyis chod pa ni/ rtogs pa de brtan du song ba dang*/ rtogs bya dang rtogs mkhan du ma ro gcig tu 'dre rgyu dang 'dres pa'i yul 'dzin rtsa ba nas dag pas bem po phyi ru ma lus/ rig pa nang du ma lus par/ snang sems gcig tu krong nge ba de/ ro gcig 'bring po yin/ yid la mi byed pa mtshan nyid pa de ru mngon du gyur pa yin/ ro gcig chen po snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad skye med kyi ngang du zhi ba'i du ma ro gcig tu rtogs la ro gcig gi rtogs pa de du ma'i snang bar shar bas/

'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rtogs pa de'i dngos gzhir gnas pa ni ro gcig du ma zhes bya ba zab rgyas dbyer med kyi don rtogs pa ste/ mdo las/ zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin zhes pa dang*/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid shin tu spros pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes gsungs pa'i don no// snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos la/ rang sa rang sa na so ma nyams/ mdog ma 'gyur bar/ ji ltar gnas pa de rang gnyis med rtogs pa'i ngo bor 'dug pa las de la bsal bzhag gam/ bral thob bam/ gnyen pos bcos rgyu spu rtse tsam yang ma gos pa ni ro gcig chen po'o// ro gcig skyes pa dang mnyam rjes 'dre ba yin te/ mnyam bzhag gi dus su gnyis chos gnyis med du krong nge ba la 'dzin pa'i dri ma med par gnas pa de la/ rjes shes snang stong gnyis med du rang ngo ma shes par/ stong par phyogs gcig tu thal 'gro ba de/ ro gcig gi rjes shes stong nyid du skye ba bya ba yin/ de la stong 'dzin yod pas nyams kyi dri ma yin/ rjes snang phal cher sgyu mar 'char yang*/ ngo ma shes kyi dri ma'ang yod/ zhang rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'di'i dus su a 'thas kyi snang ba yang yud tsam yod gsungs/ goms rjes tshogs drug gi snang ba shar ba'i dus su dran pas ma zin yang rtogs pa rgyun mi chad pas bral ba'i ngos bzung med la/ snang stong de yang dag gi dran pas gsal btab pa lta bur rjen gyis 'ong bas/ bral ba med la thob pa yod/ skyes grol dus mtshungs zhes pa yang skyes cha rang rgyud pa med la/ grol cha yod pa zhig yod/ ro gcig chen po nas gang shar gyis chog pa yin/ de la bral thob gnyis ka med do// gang shar gyi snang ba la bsal bzhag gam/ dgag sgrub med par rang sar rang ngo shes pa ro gcig gi rtogs pa yin te ngo bo mthong ba yin/ de la nges shes sam/ thag chod pa'i 'dzin pa rgyu dang 'dres pa'i dgag sgrub kyi dri ma cung zad 'dug na ro gcig gi nyams yin pas ngo bo ma mthong*/

snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos la gnyen po'i bcos rgyu skad cig ma gcig kyang med par/ rang sar rang gis chog pa'i du ma ro gcig tu rtogs la/ ro gcig gi rtogs pa de du ma'i snang ba la dbang bsgyur ba na rtsal rdzogs pa yin/ du ma ro gcig tu rtogs kyang ro gcig du mar ma shar/ gnyis chos gnyis med du rtogs kyang gnyis med gnyis chos su ma grol bas da dung bsal bzhag gam/ dgag sgrub kyi gnyen po'i 'khris dang ma bral 'dug na rtsal ma rdzogs pa yin/ rgyal thang du bla ma ldum gyi slob mas/ ti si ba'i ri pa la chos skad kyi 'ud btang ba'i lo rgyus kyang gsungs/ snang sems gcig tu 'dres pas ngar 'dzin rtsa ba nas zad cing*/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dag rang ma grub pas de la ltos pa'i gzhan ma grub ste/ bdag gzhan gnyis med gcig tu 'dres pas/ 'khrig pa'i 'dod pa dang bral phrag dog rtsa ba nas zhi/ tshogs drug zang thal gyi 'char sgo la/ bcings grol 'gro 'ong med par gang shar gyis chog na/ rnam rtog sgom du shar ba yin/ de dus ngo shes kyi dran pas thob rgyu dang grol rgyu 'dug na/ rnam rtog sgom du ma shar/ spyir tshogs drug spros bral gyi dus su 'dag nyon mongs pa'i yid ro gcig gi dus su 'dag kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa sgom med kyi dus su 'dag pa yin no// snang sems gcig tu 'dres shing rang gzhan gnyis med du shar bas/ 'byung ba la dbang thob pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes dang mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis phyi nang gi chos la dbang bsgyur bas/ dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i yon tan 'byung ste/ shes pa skad cig ma'i thog tu 'khor 'das kyi legs tshogs sgrub pa dang*/ nyes skyon spong ba dang*/ yon tan bskyed par nus pas rnam rtog la dbang bsgyur ba'o// skye gnas myong gyur gyi las bskal pa du mar mnar med du skye ba'i las lta bu bag la nyal du ma lus par rang dbang med par bslang nas/

da lta rmi lam 'khrug pa tsam zhig gis rang dag tu byed pa'am/ dge ba'i las bskal pa mang po'i pha rol du smin par byed pa yang*/ dus 'di nyid du mngon du byed pa la sogs pa/ las la dbang bsgyur/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du rtogs shing skad cig ma cha med du rtogs pas bskal pa skad cig mar byin gyis rlob pa'am/ skad cig ma bskal par byin gyis rlob pa la sogs pa dus la dbang bsgyur/ lus sems snang ba gsum gcig tu 'dres pas/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil mnyam pa dang*/ stong gsum yungs 'brur tshud pa dang*/ gcig las mang por byed pa dang*/ mang po gcig tu byed pa dang*/ rigs drug so so'i gzugs su ston cing skad du smra ba la sogs pa/ snang ba la dbang bsgyur/ mgrin pa'i rtsa kha bye/ gsung gi mdzod brdol/ ngag gi dbang phyug 'grub/ rtsom pa'i spobs pa la thogs pa med/ ston pa'i gsung rab kyi don la ma rmongs/ shes bya'i chos la chags thogs med pas ye shes la dbang bsgyur/ de rnams snang sems 'dres pa'i rten 'brel gyis mi 'ong kha med pa yin te/ dwags po ratnas/ slob dpon sgam po pa la/ ro gcig gi dus su/ lus sems snang ba gsum gcig tu 'dres pa gsungs pa de tsug lags zhus pas/ phyag dbu sngas kyi ka ba la phyal phyal mdzad nas/ de gsum de tsug 'dre ba yin gsungs/ de ltar na yon tan skyes pa yin/ ro gcig gi rtogs pa tsam skyes kyang*/ sad byed lam gyi rkyen zhen pas grub pa'i rtags rdzu 'phrul ma shar na yon tan ma skyes/ ro gcig ngang la 'byams gyur na/ rgyu 'bras mngon sum nyid du 'gyur/ de yang du ma'i snang ba rtogs pa gcig gi ngo bor dbyer med cing ro gcig gi rtogs pa des du ma'i rgyu 'bras la dbang bsgyur rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba skad cig mar rgyu 'bras 'khor lo nyi ma'i gung la za 'og bkram pa bzhin gsal/ shes pa skad cig ma'i 'char sgo la 'khor 'das 'gyes/

dge sdig gi 'dor len/ sgrib dang sbyang ba'i spel sbyang byed/ stong pa'i mtshan nyid la stong pa'i chos 'byung ba/ nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur/ bag chags kyi kun sbyor zad pas/ las 'bras skad cig gnyis par mi sdod/ 'khor 'das lam gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi 'byung rgyu/ gnas gzhi/ 'jig rkyen du shes pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'khrul 'khor/ tha na rde'u 'am shing bu gcig gi bsgyur ldog gis kyang*/ skyon yon gyi spong sgrub shes/ phyi rol gyi snang ba bya dang bye'u tshun chad kyis kyang chos tshur ston/ de ltar snang ba rang sems rang mtshan du rtogs pa'i rten 'brel rgyu 'bras kyi mtha' la mkhas pa na/ kun rdzob la byan tshud/ ro gcig sems kyi mtshan nyid rtogs pas/ snang thog tu sgro 'dogs chod pa kun rdzob shes pa'i shes rab yin/ las rgyu 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa sangs te/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes skye dgos pa la stong pa ro gcig du ma'i rgyu 'bras su ma shar na/ kun rdzob la byan ma tshud pa yin/ de ltar du ma ro gcig tu rtogs shing*/ ro gcig gi rtogs pa de du ma'i snang ba la dbang bsgyur ba'i dus su kun khyab kyi snying rje dang*/ rtsol med kyi phrin las 'byung bas/ 'khor 'das kyi bdag por gyur/ snang ba dang mi snang ba'i 'khor dang longs spyod kyi sprin 'du/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mchod cing gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa ni dbang med kyi rgyu 'bras te/ rje phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ snying nas rtsa ba chod gyur cing*// sgom ro gcig ngang la 'byams gyur na// dpal gyi ri la dar chen 'phyar// dgos dgu mi 'dod bzhin du 'byung*// de dbang med kyi rgyu 'bras ma lags sam/ gsungs so/ 'di'i dus su gzhan don la ske rags bcings pas/ dus phun sum tshogs pa lnga la rgyun chad med cing*/ tshe bsod nams kyi tshogs su mi 'gyur ba yin/

ro gcig ma skyes na gzhan don rgya chen po mi 'grub cing*/ 'grub kyang logs shig tu shor 'ong ba yin/ de ltar gzhan don gyi gter kha phyed pa na/ gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs/ du ma ro gcig gi rtogs pa skyes nas/ snang sems gcig tu 'dres pa'i dus su/ rang dang sems can gnyis su mi 'dug pa la/ su yis su'i don bya snyam pa dang*/ bla ma dang rang sems gcig tu 'dres nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ mos gus bya ba'i yul ma rnyed/ nges shes kyi nyams rtogs de'i rjes su 'brangs na nyan thos kyi gseb lam 'grims dogs kyang yod/ ro gcig 'dres pa'i rba la g.yengs bya ba'i 'khor sa yin/ sa bdun pa man chad nyan rang du ldog pa'i skabs yod pa yang de yin no// rtogs pa'i rtsal snying rje ru ma thon pas gzhan don gyi gter kha ma phyed te/ rtogs ldan gyi drod 'chag cing*/ pho hreng por ldu pa yang srid de/ bla ma ldum lta bu'am/ bgres mos zhus pa zhi mdo lta bu'o// de ltar na gzugs sku'i sa bon ma thebs/ de la dgongs nas dwags po rin po ches/ gzhan phan zhen med snying rje 'di// thabs kyi mchog tu tsir gyis bzung*// spyir mtho yin mtho yin g.yang sa che// 'phrul sa dang 'khor sa mang du yod/ spros bral dang ro gcig rtogs pa'i rang ldog tsam zhig skyes kyang*/ zab mo'i gnad nas 'dzin ma shes na cir 'gyur cha med/ lar bla ma dang gdams ngag gal che ba yin no// de ltar ro gcig ni slob pa'i zung 'jug yin/ sgom med ni mi slob pa'i zung 'jug yin te/ rtogs pa de la goms par bya rgyu med na sgom med mngon du gyur pa yin te/ de la sgom med chung ngu bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba ni/ sgom mkhan nam/ rtogs mkhan gyi mkhan po rtsa ba nas dag pas/ bsgom bya sgom byed/ rtogs bya rtogs byed/ shes bya shes byed/ dran 'dzin goms par bya rgyu'i nyams kyi dri ma rtsa ba nas dag nas/

nyin bar gyi dus na mnyam rjes med/ yengs ma yengs med par shar ba la/ mtshan bar gyi dus na sgom byed dam/ nges shes kyi dri ma cung zad cig 'dug pa de sgom med chung ngu*/ rje rgod tshang pa/ nyin bar gyi dus su rjes snang sgyu ma'am stong par gsal du mngon tsam/ yun se gol tog pa'i bar tsam re byung yang*/ dran pas bzung rgyu'i tha snyad med par de nyid du ngo bo rang dag tu 'gro ba 'ong gsungs/ sgom med 'bring po lhun grub kyi rang sa zin pa ni/ gzhi thog tu 'bras bu'i sar phyin/ sku gsum ma dang 'phrad/ yin lugs yin bzhin du mngon du gyur pas nyin mtshan med/ gnyid log ma log med par/ dran pas bzung rgyu'am/ ngo shes rgyu gtan nas med pa'i mnyam bzhag chen po gcig tu gyur pa las/ ye shes kyi rang gribs mi shes pa'i grol shes bya'i dri ma cung zad dang bcas pa de sgom med 'bring ngo*// chos kyi dbyings ye shes der shes/ ye shes chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med pas lam dang rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal gcig tu 'dres nas/ 'od gsal chen po spros med kyi ye shes la mi shes pa dang*/ shes bya'i dri ma rtsa ba nas dag nas/ tshe 'di phyi'am rgyu 'bras kyi 'dzin pa phra mo tsam yang med par rang gzhan 'khor 'das thams cad chos kyi sku gcig tu gyur pa ni/ sgom med chen po 'od gsal gnyis 'dres mi slob pa'i zung 'jug go /spyir sgom med la gsum yin gsungs/ sgom mkhan gyi shes pa rang ngo shes pa'i/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba'i sgom med de ni spros bral skyes pa dang 'ong ba yin te/ rje 'bri khung pa'i zhal nas/ sgom med kyi rnal 'byor bya ba sems rang ngo shes pa la zer ba yin gsungs/ mnyam bzhag rjes thob 'dres pas thun dang dum bu med pa'i sgom med ni/ ro gcig gi dus su 'ong ba yin te/ 'gro mgon rgya ras kyi zhal nas/ ro gcig snang ba sgom du shar/

khor yug ma ru song ba yin gsungs/ lam gyi 'od gsal dang 'bras bu'i 'od gsal gcig tu song bas/ 'od gsal gnyis 'dres pa'i sgom med ni/ sgom med dngos mthar thug pa yin te/ kyai rdo rje las/ sgom pa po med lhan cig skyes// 'di la bsgom bya yod ma yin// zhes pa'i don no// sgom med la mnyam rjes med pa'o/ rtag tu mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig yin/ dag pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes/ rjes thob dmigs med kyi snying rjer skye ba yang 'gal ba med de/ sdud pa las/ phung po 'di dag gdod nas stong zhing skye med shes// mnyam par ma bzhag sems can khams la snying rjes 'jug /bar skabs der yang sangs rgyas chos las yong mi nyams// zhes pa'i don no// nyams rtogs kyi dbye ba med/ rtogs pa'i khor yugs yin/ rtogs pa'i ngo bo la spangs rtogs kyi mtho dma' cung zad la sgom med che 'bring chung gsum du rtsi ba yin/ 'gro mgon rgya ras kyi bzhed kyis/ sgom med 'bring po dang sa bcu'i rtogs pa mnyam/ sgom med chen po sangs rgyas kyi sa yin no// de ltar rtogs pa'i ye shes la dus thams cad du dran pas bzung rgyu'am/ goms par bya rgyu'i myong ba rtsa ba nas dag pa na/ sgom med kyi ngo bo mthong*/ da rung rtogs pa de la goms par bya rgyu'am/ gsal du 'gro rgyu cung zad cig 'dug na/ ngo bo ma mthong*/ rtogs pa'i ye shes la gnyis 'dzin gyi dri ma dang*/ mi shes pa'i zol med pas shes pa dang shes bya gcig tu zad de/ ye shes chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med du gyur pa na/ sgom med kyi rtsal rdzogs/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral bas sgom mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig tu gyur kyang*/ nang du shes pa ma zad pas ye shes rang 'grib ste/ lam gyi ye shes 'bras bu'i ye shes su rnam par ma dag phyi ru shes bya ma zad pas/ ji snyed pa'i chos la gnyis snang phra mo dang ma bral 'dug na/

sgom med nyi ma sprin gyis bkab bya ba yin te rtsal ma rdzogs/ phung po lnga dang bral zhing lus med sems med/ snang ba snang med du rgya gsum grol nas/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas su dag na/ rnam rtog sgom du shar ba'o// tshogs drug dang nyon yid dag nas kun gzhi la lus sems snang ba'i 'dzin pa bag la nyal phra mo'am/ bde gsal mi rtog pa la/ nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa/ nyams kyi dri ma phra mo zhig 'dug na/ rnam rtog sgom du ma shar/ lus 'ja' lus su gyur/ sems chos skur gyur/ snod 'og min stug po bkod pa'i pho brang la/ bcud rnam par snang mdzad ye shes kyi sku/ sku lnga dbyer med kyi tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas na yon tan skyes/ thabs rten 'brel gyi 'gros ma thim zhing*/ shes rab rtogs pa'i rtsal zhan pas da rung lus sems dang snod bcud ma dag pas 'chi ba'i dus la ltos na yon tan ma skyes/ rang gzhan snod bcud brtan g.yo'i dngos po thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo chos sku gcig tu gyur pas/ yang dag par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ sems can gyi khams rgyud dang sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje gnyis su med par khyab pas 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du mchog gi sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad na gzugs sku'i phrin las kyi sa bon mngon du gyur pa yin/ da rung zhing khams gsum gyi dus la ltos na/ mngon du ma gyur pa yin/ ji lta ba dang*/ ji snyed pa dang*/ stobs dang mi 'jigs pa dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par mngon du gyur na/ kun rdzob rnam par dag cing mthar phyin pas byan tshud/ ji lta ba'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur kyang*/ ji snyed pa'i mkhyen pa phra zhing phra ba rnams rgya gsum dri mas mngon du ma gyur na/ kun rdzob rnam par ma dag ste/ byan ma tshud pa yin/ sgom chen pa'i chos skad nyams myong gi phra ba yin/ sa mtshams kyi bye brag shes par bya ba phra mo de rnams cung zad go dka' ba yin pas/

bla ma dam pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi legs par thob par byas la shes pa skad cig ma'i thog tu/ skyon yon gyi gnad mtshang rig pas/ sgro 'dogs sems thog tu chod pa gal che'o/ 'gro mgon rgya ras kyi bzhed pas/ sgom la rigs bdun du 'gyed de/ sgom lcags kyu ma ni/ 'gyus dran lkug nas sgom la 'jog pa'o// sgom 'ja' tshon ma ni gsal gsal dwangs dwangs po de gcig pu la don du byas shing sgoms pas/ rjes shes gyi snang ba rkyen dang phrad tsam na/ rtag ma thub pa'o// sgom bdag med ma ni sgom legs po gcig skyes kyang*/ skyong mkhan gyi bdag po med pas/ dred po shor ba ste/ sgom gyi mgo rkang ma tshang ba'o// de gsum rtse gcig gi dus yin gsungs/ rtogs pa skyes pa dang ngo shes kyi dran pas chog rjes snang gi gsal 'debs/ dran pas ma bskyangs kyang*/ bogs mi thon tsam ma gtogs rtsa ba nas 'chor mi srid pa'o// sgom phyogs re ma ni/ stong nyid rtogs kyang snying rje ma skyes pa'o// sgom res 'jog ma ni/ mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa rjes shes kyi thog tu mi 'dre ba dang*/ nyin bar gyi dge sbyor gnyid dang rmi lam gyi dus su mi 'drongs pa ste/ de gnyis spros bral 'bring po man chad kyi dus yin gsungs/ sgom khor yug ma ni/ mnyam rjes dang nyin mtshan thun mtshams med pa ste/ ro gcig chen po'i dus yin gsungs/ sgom rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po ma ni/ zung 'jug gi rtogs pa la goms par bya rgyu med par/ snang srid la dbang bsgyur bas/ mi slob pa'i lam gyi mthar thug ste/ sgom med chen po'i dus yin gsungs so// yang rtse gcig nyams kyi snang cha yin// 'jig rten lam ste las rnams sog /spros bral pha yul mthong ba yin// rdzun snang nges med ltad mor che// ro gcig snang ba sgom du shar// khor yug ma ru song ba yin// sgom med chos sku'i rgyal sa zin// bya rtsol thams cad dbyings su thim/

gsungs/ rje 'bri khung pa'i zhal nas/ sgom gyi rtsa ba rtse gcig dus su tshugs dgos/ rtogs pa'i gzugs rus spros bral dus su thon dgos/ ro gcig phan chad rgyu drug 'dzom pa'i bzo yin sla gsungs/ rje dwags po rin po che'i nye gnas lo bcu gnyis byas pa'i dwags po glan sgom bya bas/ slob dpon sgom pa ba la rnal 'byor bzhi'i khyad par cig zhu byas pas rtse gcig sems kyi rang bzhin shes pa yin/ spros bral stong pa'i rang bzhin shes pa yin/ ro gcig snang ba'i rang bzhin shes pa yin/ sgom med dam de nga la med gsungs/ yang rtse gcig nal gyi bu dang 'dra// skyes pa mang ste khas len nyung*// spros bral spyi rta rgal can 'dra// kha 'dzin mang ste ched gnyer nyung*// ro gcig gter gyi kha byang 'dra// gleng ba mang ste thon pa nyung*// sgom med rgyal po'i gdan sa 'dra// smon pa mang ste thob pa nyung*/ gsungs so// ༈ ma bcos rkyen gsum bral ba snying po'i don// gnyug ma 'gro 'ong med pa phyag rgya che// mos gus mchog tu gyur pa'i skal ldan la// byin brlabs stobs kyis 'char gyis brtags pas min// bla ma'i drin gyis sems kyi ngo bo mthong*// goms pa'i stobs kyis rjes shes dri ma dag /gong ma'i gsung dang rang gi myong ba'i gnad// gzhan la phan phyir yi ge bkod pa yin// dge ba 'di yis mkha' mnyam sems can kun// phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa mngon gyur shog /phyag rgya chen po rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa/ bla ma dam pa'i gsung las cung zad rgyas par phye ba/ snying po don gyi gter mdzod ces bya ba/ ku su lu'i sprang po yang dgon pas/ dpal lha sdings kyi dgon par yi ger bkod pa rdzogs so// dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las gcig 'dus pa// sa gsum bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon yang dgon pas// theg gsum gdams pa'i gnad dril rnal 'byor gyi// bzhi gsum bcu gnyis sa lam gsal byed 'di// dben gsum lhur len la dwags wa gind+ras// 'khor gsum dmigs med chos sbyin par bzhengs dges// sku gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa gsal ba dang*// khams gsum srid pa'i drwa ba skem par shog
